propositions: Core must compare only canonical local-vocabulary shapes; vendor payloads cross core solely as opaque payloads at mapper boundaries (OutboundMapper.map_local_to_remote, InboundMapper.map_remote_to_local)
All package-root reconciler core modules must have zero imports of adapters.jira, acli_subprocess, or lazy-key literals, with single recorded exemption for inbound_fields.py
The outbound differ must canonicalize fetched snapshots via InboundMapper and build vendor payloads exclusively via injected OutboundMapper at emission, achieving parity with inbound_differ
Backend interface must be pinned and enforced; all transport construction and provider literals must route through select_backend() and the port
Eight vendor modules (acli*, adf, outbound_fields, comment_limits) must be physically relocated into adapters/jira/ with loaders repointed and no re-export shims
Remaining open children must implement canonical field diff, canonical link diff, SupportsAbsenceProbe, and rich-text/comment-limit paths behind port interfaces
